questions.text: Boy, an older student dares you to climb the tallest tower at midnight. What do you do?

answers.GRYFFINDOR: Take the dare and start climbing at once.
answers.RAVENCLAW: Work out the safest route before I move.
answers.HUFFLEPUFF: Refuse, and invite him to share my supper instead.
answers.SLYTHERIN: Dare him back, and make sure everyone sees.

questions.text: A great exam is tomorrow, and you are not ready. How do you spend the night?

answers.GRYFFINDOR: Trust my nerve and sleep soundly.
answers.RAVENCLAW: Read until I understand every last detail.
answers.HUFFLEPUFF: Study patiently, and help a friend who is struggling.
answers.SLYTHERIN: Find out exactly what will be asked, and prepare only that.

questions.text: Your closest friend is cornered by bullies, and you are outnumbered. What now?

answers.GRYFFINDOR: Charge in and stand beside my friend.
answers.RAVENCLAW: Think of a clever distraction to scatter them.
answers.HUFFLEPUFF: Stay by my friend, whatever it costs me.
answers.SLYTHERIN: Slip away and return with someone who frightens them.

questions.text: You find an old door, locked tight, deep in the castle. How do you open it?

answers.GRYFFINDOR: Throw my shoulder against it until it gives.
answers.RAVENCLAW: Study the lock and the carvings for a clue.
answers.HUFFLEPUFF: Leave it, and ask who it belongs to.
answers.SLYTHERIN: Find whoever holds the key, and make a bargain.

questions.text: The forest path splits in three. Which would you choose?

answers.GRYFFINDOR: The dark and dangerous path, where the adventure waits.
answers.RAVENCLAW: The strange path nobody has ever explained.
answers.HUFFLEPUFF: The sunny path, where I can walk with company.
answers.SLYTHERIN: The hidden path, which leads somewhere others cannot follow.

questions.text: You discover a chest of gold that belongs to nobody you can name. What do you do?

answers.GRYFFINDOR: Hand it over, even if I could have used it.
answers.RAVENCLAW: Examine it first, for a riddle on the lid.
answers.HUFFLEPUFF: Share it out fairly among everyone nearby.
answers.SLYTHERIN: Keep it quiet, and spend it wisely.

questions.text: Which of these would sting you the most?
A rule seems foolish, and breaking it would help someone. What do you do?

answers.GRYFFINDOR: Break it boldly, and take whatever follows.
answers.RAVENCLAW: Argue the rule is wrong, and prove it.
answers.HUFFLEPUFF: Keep it, and look for a kinder way to help.
answers.SLYTHERIN: Bend it quietly, so nobody can blame me.

questions.text: You are given a dull, tiring task that nobody will ever praise. How do you do it?

answers.GRYFFINDOR: Quickly, so I can find something braver to do.
answers.RAVENCLAW: By inventing a cleverer way to do it.
answers.HUFFLEPUFF: Steadily and well, because it needs doing.
answers.SLYTHERIN: Only if it brings me something I want.

questions.text: Years from now, what would you most wish to be remembered for?

answers.GRYFFINDOR: A brave deed that others still speak of.
answers.RAVENCLAW: A discovery that changed what people knew.
answers.HUFFLEPUFF: Being a true friend to everyone I met.
answers.SLYTHERIN: Rising higher than anyone believed I could.
